decisions.reason: The existing same-message update establishes manual redemption but leaves several About-page attributes describing automatic prize payout and no redemption control. Those attributes must be revised to avoid contradictory current copy.

decisions.reason: The landing-page state contains prize-frequency and commission marketing copy but no current automatic-payout or claim-control rule requiring revision.
Winner email notification and guidance remain required regardless of whether the prize is collected through a temporary claim control.
The prize-claim clarification does not affect book-cover placement, cropping, visibility, or size.
Manual prize redemption does not change the established email authentication or dashboard-access behavior.
The claim-control decision does not alter Transak wallet provisioning, fiat conversion, mint destination, or supported payment methods.
A same-message MODIFY already records manual redemption through a control visible only during the eligibility window, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The prize-claim mechanism does not change SIWE support, protected wallet flows, or Transak-created-wallet dashboard access.
The local decision concerns prize redemption only. FAQ references to automatic commissions do not modify the independently established coded-referral commission amount or payout rules.
Changing prize collection from automatic payout to manual redemption does not alter Chainlink VRF winner selection.
The claim-control clarification does not affect the NFT token serial used as the referral identity or where that identity is displayed.
The local decision establishes prize redemption behavior, not the number or recipient of tickets issued for coded referrals. Descriptive FAQ overlap does not authorize a ticket-rule change.
